# Oliver's mTOR Atlas

> The mTOR pathway, mapped by what the evidence can actually carry. Every claim carries its source, the conditions it was measured under, and the point where its validity ends -- species, sex, dose, nutrient state, duration. 518 published studies labelled by study type (S = synthesis of human data, H = human study, A = animal model, M = molecular/in vitro, R = review), linked to a knowledge graph of genes, drugs, diseases and outcomes, plus a layer of named knowledge gaps and testable hypotheses: what the literature has tested and failed to show, and what it has not tested at all. Content is CC BY 4.0 -- free to cite and reuse with attribution to "Oliver's mTOR Atlas".

## Start here
- [Browse the Atlas](https://mtor-atlas.org/browse/): plain-HTML index of every study and topic page
- [The mTOR pathway, node by node](https://mtor-atlas.org/pathway/): the full pathway model (100 nodes, 138 interactions, 11 guided routes) as text -- the static form of the interactive pathway map
- [mTOR conferences & meetings](https://mtor-atlas.org/events/): upcoming and past conferences relevant to mTOR, autophagy and longevity research
- [About & Methodology](https://mtor-atlas.org/about/): who curates this, how a study is selected and evidence-graded, what the grading doesn't guarantee, correction policy
- [Full interactive Atlas](https://mtor-atlas.org/): the SPA (pathway map, AI research assistant, timeline) -- requires JavaScript
- [Data & Citation](https://mtor-atlas.org/data/): dataset DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22059963, bio.tools/FAIRsharing registration, ORCID, license, how to cite
- [Evidence audit](https://mtor-atlas.org/evidence/audit/): what the corpus is actually built on -- share of human evidence, how much of the pathway has any human data behind it, how many links rest on a single paper, how much carries a recorded boundary condition; every figure recomputed from the corpus on each build
- [Timing](https://mtor-atlas.org/pathway/timing/): how mTOR interventions were delivered over time -- acute, intermittent, chronic, withdrawal-tested -- and which pathway links are known to depend on duration; plus time inside the cell: how each study reads the signal (snapshot, time course, live single cells, cell cycle, 24-hour clock, model) and which negative feedback loops on the map have ever been followed in time
- [Does the pattern matter more than the average?](https://mtor-atlas.org/pathway/timing/pattern/): the open question of whether the pattern of mTORC1 activity over time, not just its average level, decides outcomes like autophagy or growth -- what has been measured, what has only been modelled, and what no study in the atlas has done yet

- [The Field](https://mtor-atlas.org/field/): how mTOR research got here -- timeline, turning points, and where the field stands now
- [Topics](https://mtor-atlas.org/topics/): entry points by gene, drug, disease, process and outcome
- [mTOR drugs in development](https://mtor-atlas.org/pipeline/): selective mTORC1 inhibitors, rapalogs in ageing trials and stopped programmes -- stage, status, sources and what the Atlas evidence says
- [All interactions](https://mtor-atlas.org/pathway/interactions/): every modelled pathway interaction with mechanism, boundary condition and evidence
- [Guided routes](https://mtor-atlas.org/pathway/routes/): eleven narrated paths through the pathway model
- [API](https://mtor-atlas.org/api/): static read-only JSON API -- studies, entities, evidence-linked pathway relations and open questions; OpenAPI: https://mtor-atlas.org/api/openapi.json
- [MCP server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mtor-atlas-mcp): connect an AI assistant to the Atlas: remote server https://mtor-atlas-mcp.mtor-atlas.workers.dev/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no auth) or locally `npx -y mtor-atlas-mcp`. Plugins for Claude Code (`/plugin marketplace add open-mtor-atlas/mtor-atlas-plugins`) and Gemini CLI (`gemini extensions install https://github.com/open-mtor-atlas/mtor-atlas-plugins`): https://github.com/open-mtor-atlas/mtor-atlas-plugins

## Learn the mechanisms (mTOR Academy)
Short, question-led lessons that build the mental model most mTOR papers assume. Every mechanistic claim links to the Atlas study behind it, with that study's evidence code attached, and every lesson names what is still uncertain.
- [mTOR Academy](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/): course overview and entry points
- [mTOR Core curriculum](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/): 10-lesson sequence
- [01 - What is mTOR?](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/what-is-mtor/): The kinase that decides whether a cell builds or recycles
- [02 - mTORC1 vs mTORC2](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/mtorc1-vs-mtorc2/): Why one kinase works inside two different machines
- [03 - Rheb — The Critical Regulator](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/rheb/): A small GTPase, a brake, and a question about where things are
- [04 - The TSC Complex — Where the Inputs Meet](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/tsc-and-rheb/): One brake, four kinds of bad news, and a disease that shows what happens when it fails
- [05 - The Lysosome as a Signalling Platform](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/lysosome-platform/): Why the cell's recycling compartment turned out to be where the growth decision is made
- [06 - Nutrient Sensing](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/nutrient-sensing/): How a cell reads individual amino acids &mdash; and why the wiring is a chain of double negatives
- [07 - Growth Factor Signalling](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/growth-factor-signaling/): How a cell learns that the rest of the organism is asking it to grow
- [08 - Feedback Regulation](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/feedback-regulation/): Why inhibiting mTORC1 can make signalling upstream of it go up
- [09 - mTOR and Autophagy](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/mtor-and-autophagy/): The recycling program mTORC1 holds down, and what happens when it lets go
- [10 - How to Read an mTOR Paper](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/core/how-to-read-an-mtor-paper/): Six habits that survive contact with the literature
- [Free courses and lectures](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/free-courses/): 33 free courses, lectures and readings elsewhere (MITx, Coursera, iBiology, FutureLearn), each with level, certificate and how much mTOR it covers
- [Practice Arena](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/practice/): short games on the pathway model, scored on calibration rather than speed
- [Qualifying Exam](https://mtor-atlas.org/academy/qual/): ten hard questions for people who work on mTOR, placed by accuracy and calibration

## Direct answers & glossary
Plain-language answers to the questions people most often ask about mTOR, rapamycin and longevity, each graded by the same evidence system used throughout the Atlas.
- [Answers index](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/): all 10 answer pages
- [Does rapamycin extend lifespan in humans?](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/rapamycin-lifespan-humans/)
- [mTORC1 vs mTORC2 -- what's the difference?](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/mtorc1-vs-mtorc2/)
- [What are mTOR inhibitors? The full list](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/mtor-inhibitors-list/)
- [What are rapamycin's side effects?](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/rapamycin-side-effects/)
- [Is autophagy actually required for the lifespan benefit?](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/autophagy-required-lifespan/)
- [How is rapamycin dosed in the longevity studies?](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/rapamycin-dosing-longevity/)
- [What is mTOR?](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/what-is-mtor/)
- [Rapamycin vs metformin -- how do they compare?](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/rapamycin-vs-metformin/)
- [Are sirolimus and everolimus the same drug?](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/sirolimus-everolimus-same-drug/)
- [How does mTOR connect to cancer?](https://mtor-atlas.org/answers/mtor-cancer-connection/)
- [Glossary of mTOR terms](https://mtor-atlas.org/glossary/): 25 core terms, linked to the full Atlas entry for each

## Open questions & testable hypotheses
Original synthesis, not aggregated abstracts -- each page states an evidence gap, a hypothesis and a proposed experiment.
- [Sensor-selective geroprotection without the metabolic penalty](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/sensor-selective-geroprotection-without-the-metabolic-penalty/)
- [How much of rapamycin's healthspan benefit runs through fewer senescent cells?](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/suppression-of-senescence-sasp-geroconversion-not-just-autophagy-is-the-mediator-of-rapamycins-healthspan-benefit/)
- [Does mTORC1-selective dosing extend lifespan, and is rapamycin's glucose intolerance a cost at all?](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/mtorc1-selective-mtorc2-sparing-dosing-captures-longevity-without-insulin-resistance/)
- [Muscle-sparing, pulsed mTORC1 inhibition](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/muscle-sparing-pulsed-mtorc1-inhibition/)
- [Is autophagy actually REQUIRED for the mammalian lifespan benefit?](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/is-autophagy-actually-required-for-the-mammalian-lifespan-benefit/)
- [A sensor/autophagy biomarker panel as a surrogate endpoint for human trials](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/a-sensor-autophagy-biomarker-panel-as-a-surrogate-endpoint-for-human-trials/)
- [Does the larger rapamycin benefit in female mice survive equal drug exposure, and is it set by hormones or by chromosomes?](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/sex-dimorphism-in-mtor-longevity-responses-is-pervasive-and-sometimes-direction-flipping/)
- [Is there a low-dose mTOR schedule whose immune effects come out favourable, compartment by compartment?](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/low-dose-mtor-inhibition-rejuvenates-the-aging-immune-system-without-net-immunosuppression/)
- [Brain-penetrant mTOR inhibition clears aggregates in models, but human dosing has not been shown to reach the brain — and mTORC2 is needed for memory in mice](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/brain-penetrant-mtor-inhibition-clears-neurodegenerative-aggregates-in-models-but-has-zero-human-cognitive-aging-endpoint-and-mtorc2-is-needed-for-memory/)
- [Rapamycin + AMPK-axis drugs (acarbose / metformin): a male-mouse survival signal from cross-cohort comparison, untested in humans](https://mtor-atlas.org/question/rapamycin-ampk-axis-drugs-acarbose-metformin-potentially-additive-redundant-or-synergistic-and-untested-as-a-combination-in-humans/)

## Core pathway entities

## Machine-readable
- [Data & Citation](https://mtor-atlas.org/data/): dataset DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22059963, ORCID, license, bio.tools/FAIRsharing registration, citation string
- [Data exports (CSV/JSON)](https://mtor-atlas.org/data/exports/): the full corpus as flat files, regenerated on every deploy
- [Corrections log](https://mtor-atlas.org/changelog/): every change to the method (selection, grading, reading of evidence), with date and reason
- [Sitemap index](https://mtor-atlas.org/sitemap.xml)
- [robots.txt](https://mtor-atlas.org/robots.txt)
